links.outcome: Readability of chatbot patient education responses relative to average American reading level
links.effect: No significant readability differences among four chatbots; all responses averaged above the average American reading level.
links.quote: There were no significant differences in readability among the four different chatbots and they all provided responses that averaged above the average American reading level.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the readability and informational quality (DISCERN) of four LLM chatbots for patient education regarding patellar tendon rupture without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
